items.statement: Molecular nitrate coordination and ligand arrangement
items.expected: A relaxed full neutral singlet IrCl2(NO3)(PPh3)2 model supports bidentate nitrate with two Ir–O contacts, an acute O–Ir–O bite and a remote third O in a pseudo-octahedral environment with approximately trans chlorides. Give actual mapped distances/angles. This is a modeled structure, not proof that IR uniquely identifies a global minimum. A demonstrated physically equivalent description passes.

items.statement: Physical origin of the differentiated nitrate stretching pattern
items.expected: Explain the nitrate stretching pattern from actual intranitrate bond lengths and mode displacement/force-coordinate evidence: two longer coordinated N–O bonds support lower in-phase and middle out-of-phase stretching, while the shorter terminal N–O dominates the higher, strongly IR-active stretch. Give calculated frequencies in cm^-1, intensities with units and any fixed scaling convention. The final bond–vibration relationship is scored; no fixed mode IDs, displacement-fraction thresholds, exact printed frequencies or prescribed analysis method is required.

items.statement: Physical interpretation of the 1261 cm^-1 neighborhood
items.expected: For the supplied 1261 cm^-1 KBr feature, actual molecular mode character supports ligand/PPh3 contributions in the relevant nearby calculated modes, rather than an automatic nitrate-stretch assignment. Report the comparison in cm^-1 and qualify what it establishes for the experiment. A nearest-frequency match alone does not identify an experimental mode.

Actual computed frequencies, IR activity and displacement evidence relate the high nitrate stretch to the 1532/1561 cm^-1 region while distinguishing nearby ligand modes. Preserve the differing experimental accounts and report residuals to both stated observations without silently choosing one or fitting a per-band correction. The reference raw high nitrate mode is 1511.2095 cm^-1, not a new target or exact reproduction claim.

items.statement: What molecular IR can establish about the KBr observations
items.expected: Use the demonstrated band/mode comparisons to conclude that the isolated molecular model gives selective structural/spectral support but does not uniquely assign all supplied KBr bands or establish the solid-state population. Identify a concrete unresolved assignment/environment or scaling ambiguity affecting that inference. Merely repeating generic uncertainty earns no credit; the experimental bands themselves are not predictions.
